emotions_and_vibe: Cinematic, premium, editorial, adventurous, raw but refined, high-end travel journal

rules: No Inter, Roboto, or standard web sans for headings.
Headings strictly uppercase with tight or wide tracking depending on weight.
Details and overlines use uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).

central_concept_implementation.description: A scroll-linked motorcycle path that drifts organically from top to bottom, avoiding center alignment, leaving large negative space.
technical_instructions: Use framer-motion useScroll to track page progress.
Create a fixed or absolutely positioned full-height SVG that spans from the hero bottom to the footer.
Draw the path using a <path> element. To animate drawing the path, use motion.path with pathLength bound to scrollYProgress.
To move the motorcycle along the path, use CSS offset-path (offsetPath in React) on a motion.div containing the motorcycle image, and bind offsetDistance from 0% to 100% based on scroll progress.
Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling is active to make the scroll-linked animation feel premium.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Use massive spacing (py-24, py-32, py-48) to create the 'premium editorial' negative space.
layouts_and_grids.experiences_section: Use the 'Tetris' Bento Grid protocol. Asymmetrical. Images overlap the central path slightly. Col-span 8, 4, etc. No perfect alignment.
layouts_and_grids.footer: Massive py-40, text-[8vw] CTA 'THE WORLD IS CALLING.', background landscape image with bg-black/50 overlay.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (pointer-events-none, mix-blend-overlay, opacity-5) over solid sections.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero and Footer images must use maximum bg-black/50. No pure black blankets.
visual_enhancers.transitions: Gentle parallax on large images. Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform for y-axis offset.

components.navigation: Sticky header. Starts with dark glassmorphism (surface_glass_dark) over hero to ensure visibility. On scroll, transitions to surface_glass_light for light sections. Must include 'EXPEDITIONS, DESTINATIONS, EXPERIENCES, INFO & FAQ, JOURNAL'.
components.hero: 100vh. Autoplay muted video or fallback cinematic image. Includes eyebrow 'THIS IS 7HUES' and H1 'NOT JUST A RIDE. AN EXPERIENCE YOU CARRY BACK.' Includes video progress UI and 'BOOK YOUR RIDE' CTA.
components.journal_cards: Editorial cinematic cards. Image height 400px. Title overlaps image slightly. Categories in Space Mono.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none), 1px border or solid deep blue/gold. No pills for this brand. Premium, aggressive but refined.

image_urls.description: Dark cinematic mountain road for hero fallback
Top view of motorcycle for path animation

accessibility: Prefers-reduced-motion: true to disable parallax and scroll-linked animations. APCA contrast ratios. data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use .js files for React components, avoid .tsx.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Use glassmorphism or solid gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles, for this brand use sharp geometric buttons.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
